data_provenance: REAL PUBLIC data: GM12878 (NA12878) ONT direct-RNA, ENCODE ENCSR368UNC (rep1 ENCFF957IFS); SQANTI3 vs GENCODE v49. Pangenome junctions = whole-genome HPRC v1.1 Minigraph-Cactus deletions >=50bp (71,435 junctions, all chr1-22/X/Y). NA12878 is OUT of the HPRC graph's 47 assembly samples (non-circular).
notes: Whole-genome pangenome SPECIFICITY on real public data (extends GATE-1 chr22 -> whole-genome): 0 false rescues among 13,017 real GM12878 novel isoforms vs 71,435 whole-genome HPRC population-deletion junctions. A proximity scan found NO novel junction within +/-2 bp of a population deletion -> genuinely no coincidence (not a matching-strictness artifact): the novel junctions are real splice sites, not population-deletion reference bias. So the pangenome axis is a high-specificity guardrail, not a high-yield discovery axis -- reference-bias-via-population-deletion is rare in typical samples. The BAM mapping axis additionally flagged 390 novel isoforms as mapping artifacts. Fully public/reproducible (no private data).
